provenance.procedure: GET /configuration with an Authorization: Bearer <v4 read access token>; synthesised from the published TMDB v3 /configuration contract (ADR-0026). Regenerate against a real token with scripts/capture-fixtures.sh tmdb configuration.
provenance.note: Synthesised: TMDB's public /configuration is the cheapest authenticated GET, so the health Check uses it to EXERCISE the token — a 200 proves the token was accepted. Nothing in the body is read; a concrete decode target keeps the check honest rather than discarding the body.
